-- Blinding the whole encoder is one line and covers every published list at once.

-- Chronicle public fields are calculated by the same native projections used
-- by rules. Keep their printed counterparts for card display and inspection.
chronicleWithStats :: ToJSON a => a -> [(Key.Key, Value)] -> Value
chronicleWithStats original entries = case toJSON original of
  Object fields -> Object $ foldl' (\current (key, value) -> KeyMap.insert key value current) fields entries
  other -> other

chroniclePublicInvestigator :: (HasGame m, ToJSON a) => InvestigatorId -> a -> m Value
chroniclePublicInvestigator iid original = do
  health <- field InvestigatorHealth iid
  sanity <- field InvestigatorSanity iid
  willpower <- getSkillValue #willpower iid
  intellect <- getSkillValue #intellect iid
  combat <- getSkillValue #combat iid
  agility <- getSkillValue #agility iid
  pure $ chronicleWithStats original
    [ ("currentHealth", toJSON health), ("currentSanity", toJSON sanity)
    , ("currentWillpower", toJSON willpower), ("currentIntellect", toJSON intellect)
    , ("currentCombat", toJSON combat), ("currentAgility", toJSON agility)
    ]

chroniclePublicEnemy :: (HasGame m, ToJSON a) => EnemyId -> a -> m Value
chroniclePublicEnemy eid original = do
  health <- field EnemyHealth eid
  evade <- field EnemyEvade eid
  game <- getGame
  -- Fight can depend on the active investigator. No such query is legal while
  -- a game has no investigators seated; retain its optional native value.
  fight <- if null (gameInvestigators game) then pure Nothing else field EnemyFight eid
  pure $ chronicleWithStats original
    [("currentHealth", toJSON health), ("currentFight", toJSON fight), ("currentEvade", toJSON evade)]

chroniclePublicLocation :: (HasGame m, ToJSON a) => LocationId -> a -> m Value
chroniclePublicLocation lid original = do
  shroud <- field LocationShroud lid
  pure $ chronicleWithStats original [("currentShroud", toJSON shroud)]

-- Blinding the whole encoder is one line and covers every published list at once.
let allLocations' = Map.map toJSON locations <> enemyLocationViews

locations' <- Map.traverseWithKey chroniclePublicLocation locations
    let allLocations' = locations' <> enemyLocationViews
